heroHeadline: Vera C. Rubin Observatory Begins Its Ten-Year Survey of the Universe
heroSubtitle: LSST science operations are underway from Cerro Pachón, Chile — the 3,200-megapixel LSST Camera is capturing a new image roughly every 40 seconds, generating unprecedented nightly alert volumes and a growing stream of asteroid and transient discoveries.
